info.name: messenger-api
info.description:
Postman collection for the messenger-api REST surface. Pair this with the `messenger-api (local)` environment file in the same directory. The Auth → Login request captures `accessToken` / `refreshToken` into env vars; every other request uses `{{accessToken}}` via Bearer auth at the collection root.

The canonical contract is `docs/api/openapi.yaml` (interactive at `GET /docs`). See `docs/api/REST.md` for the long-form documentation behind each request.
